ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Old Sock and Memphis fit my current blues mood, so this is the one I would choose first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues and roots rock right now rather than traditional pop standards.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: People, Hell & Angels has me interested in more guitar-led blues, so I would try this too.
ItemID: NA; Title: Play All Night: Live at The Beacon Theatre 1992; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock sound appeals, but I would save a long live album for another time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nathaniel Rateliff & The Night Sweats; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-and-soul direction sounds promising, but I am sticking with my two strongest choices today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Heaven & Earth; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Progressive rock is not what I want from this listening session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Popular Problems; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues playing right now than a lyric-focused singer-songwriter album.
ItemID: NA; Title: The River & The Thread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blown Away leaves me open to more country-rooted music, but this is a lower priority today.
ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Melodic rock could suit me, but I am choosing the blues albums this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its reflective songwriting could fit my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would leave it for later.
